mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20d SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the average 20d return in low FEDFUNDS periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness and economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a sharp contraction in consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20d returns in more than 40% of cases (i.e., negative returns occur in less than 60% of instances).

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced economic output and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST increases do not produce positive 20d returns in at least 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 220.0 (CPIAUCSL), it signals persistent high inflation, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, which is a leading indicator of negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise) fails to produce negative 5d returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong supply-side economic activity and growth, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO increases do not produce positive 20d returns in at least 55% of cases.
